questions.q: What has to happen for the game to start?
o: Pick up the receiver of the black phone
questions.e: In the video: "Ali niko još nema hrabrosti da podigne slušalicu" — but nobody has the courage yet to pick up the receiver.
In the video: "Negde u centru grada nalazi se žuti kofer" — somewhere in the city centre there is a yellow suitcase.

questions.q: How long do you have to find the suitcase?
questions.e: In the video: "Imaš minut vremena da ga pronađeš" — you have a minute to find it.

questions.q: How many euros did the guy get for following Luka?
questions.e: In the video: "Pošto si rekao da me pratiš, zaslužuješ 100 evra" — since you said you follow me, you deserve 100 euros.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Ali niko još nema hrabrosti da podigne *slušalicu*.
questions.e: Slušalica — a receiver (of a phone), also a headphone.

questions.q: Jel može za vas jedan *buket* cveća?
Imaš minut vremena da ga pronađeš. *Srećno*.
questions.e: Srećno — a wish of good luck.

questions.q: Tvoj sledeći zadatak je da pronađeš ___.
questions.e: The verb "to find" takes the accusative: Luku Averića.

questions.q: Postavio sam crni telefon u ___ grada.
questions.e: The preposition u answering "where?" takes the locative: u centru.

questions.q: Pošto si rekao da me ___, zaslužuješ 100 evra.
questions.e: We are talking about "you" — 2nd person singular: pratiš.

questions.q: Da li me možda pratiš na ___ mrežama?
questions.e: The preposition na + "where?" takes the locative plural: na društvenim mrežama.
